text:
[Previous context: The Government
and the Bank agreed on an Additional Financing loan of EUR 9.0 million in 2010, and the Project was extended for 3 years
to complete the additional activities, including the digital cadastre map and a national spatial data infrastructure which will
contribute to more and better services to citizens and other government partners.

Results achieved:

Since the project's start in 2005:] The coverage of the territory of the country with real estate cadastre grew from 43% in to 99.8%.
The annual number of registered transactions tripled: the average number of transactions per month increased from

42,116 in 2005 to 120,742 in 2011.

[Context: 42,116 in 2005 to 120,742 in 2011.]
Annual mortgages registered in the land administration system doubled from 3,000 in 2005 to more than 9,800 in 2011,
demonstrating a substantial increase in using ownership rights as collateral. Since the project began, over 50,000

mortgages were registered.

In 90% of offices in the country, the project reduced the time to register a sale transaction to 5 days or less-down

from 60 days in 2004.
